{{Quote|I don't recognize that manufacturer. And isn't Badfellow Station just a cargo-routing hub?|Garik Loran|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Badfellow Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] at coordinates M-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> A civilian routing yard, it handled contract warehousing and redistribution for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|navy]].
